description: List test cases in a project or one folder (see listFolders). Filters: id, case_type, priority, paging. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

custom_fields.description: Custom field name to value, e.g. {"Theme": "Checkout"}.

folder_id.description: Only this folder's cases (ids from listFolders).

id.description: Comma-separated test case ids, e.g. TC-12,TC-34.

name: listTestCases
